text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...That was an amazing race, Brian.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You've gotten stronger again—to the
point that
no one can catch up.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: No fair!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: No fair! No fair! No fair! I was supposed to win! Not Brian!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win next time for sure!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Talk about bratty...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I should've won...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
If that's how you feel, then keep chasing
after me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'll race you as many times as it takes. If
there's a
race, I'll always be there.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
O-okay! And I won't lose! Because I'll
become so
craaazy strong!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heh. I suppose I should be that honest
as well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat you too, Brian.
Someday, even
if I can't right now.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Without question.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Do it then.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Brian... This is your strength.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You dominate the field with astounding

aggression, seizing and reshaping the
hearts of
those watching.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Among those hearts, doubtless some
were turned
to resignation. But, in
truth...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Everyone was captivated by you and
your
unparalleled ability...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Each individual praying that they could
one day
defeat such strength.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's the kind of strength that attracts
those who
live wholly for racing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So much so, even I wish to indulge
myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...So that's it for this year.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: And what a year it was!

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I did.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Heh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: You know I'm not.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm still hungry. When I think about the
new year,
all I can imagine is a new
generation of
competition and running
more races.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I can barely contain myself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
